programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Tiger Eyes
programs.desc: Hunter the Sumatran tiger is blind and must be sedated for his annual eye check  the keepers prepare young giraffe Scarlett for a road trip to South Australia, reuniting her with family.

programs.title: Meet the Orangutans: Settling In
programs.desc: One orphan is new on the scene and needs another, more experienced one to help them settle in  the babies are at high risk from parasites ingested from the ground.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: Sold Into Slavery
programs.desc: Ivan is investigating the illegal trade of bush meat in Kinshasa when he stumbles upon three captive baby chimpanzees that are being sold on the black market.

programs.title: Return to Shark Vortex
programs.desc: As the Shark Vortex retreats in the fall, sharks battle it out for dominance in New England's icy waters  experts Dr. Greg Skomal, Joe and Lauren Romeiro brave rough oceans and fierce predators to capture new footage and insight.

programs.title: The Zoo: Otter Under the Weather
programs.desc: A 14-year-old otter is not its usual, energetic self  staff at the New York Aquarium move their sharks to a new exhibit  quirky capercaillies need help producing healthy chicks.

programs.title: My Cat From Hell: Pee Battle
programs.desc: Jackson deals with a mother-daughter duo whose lovable cats have pissing matches that are destroying not only their furniture but also their relationship  the Cat Daddy connects with Cat From Heaven, Ziggy, who has CPR skills.
